title: The Ethics Engine: A Modular Pipeline for Accessible Psychometric Assessment of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The focus was on psychometric assessment of political and moral values, specifically authoritarianism (Right-Wing and Left-Wing) and moral foundations.
findings: No findings related to religion were reported as it was not a focus of the study.
